name: far-field ground motions
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 远离震源或断层近场影响区域的地震动。
usage_overview: 在车辆—高架桥系统的地震响应分析中，用作与近断层地震记录比较的输入集合，为考察不同地震动情景下的系统响应差异提供参照。

complete_examples.text: On the other hand, the results in this study may coincide with Kabir et al.’s founding – the numerical results indicate that long-duration ground motions affect the bridge components more than near-fault and far-field ground motions [36].
